title: happy's: a concept site for a downtown Cary cocktail bar
tag: Concept site · cocktail bar, Cary, NC
summaryLead: A concept site for a downtown Cary cocktail bar. Not a launched project.
story: happy's is a cocktail bar and event space in downtown Cary, NC, known for its wall of smiley faces. This concept is our own work, made to show how that personality, a long menu and irregular hours could live on one loud, friendly page. We built it as a single hand-written file, with a colour-coded searchable menu and a climb up the stairs to the walk up.

features.title: The smiley wall
features.text: The bar's own wall sets the hero and the cream and tomato palette.

features.title: Colour-coded menu
features.text: 60 items in ten sections, with category chips, live search and a running tab (for fun).

features.title: The walk up
features.text: Twelve CSS-only 3D steps in a native dialog. Skipped for reduced motion.
